Car me sheher route hota hai. Metro me map hota hai. Paidal, sheher kahani ban jata hai.

Ek hi raaste par chalne se details dikhne lagti hain: woh dukaan jiska shutter hamesha aadha khula rehta hai; pavement par woh tree root jo logon ko halka sa turn lene par majboor karta hai; ek ghar jahan 6 baje se pehle pressure cooker ki seeti aati hai.

Ek route chuno aur har walk par sirf ek category notice karo: darwaze, awaazein, cheezein jo repair ho rahi hain, ya log kaise rukte hain. Photo mat lo. Pehle dekho.

Yaadon ko sambhalne ka simple tareeqa [[Yaad rakhne ka halka tareeqa]] me hai. Dekhna shuru karna ho toh [[Chai ki aakhri chuski]] se shuru karo.
